proof_body:
by
  intro g c a b R hg ha hb hab
  have hR : 0 < R := Metric.pos_of_mem_ball ha
  have hab' : a - b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab
  have hne : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball c R, ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c R, z - w ≠ 0 := by
    intro w hw z hz h
    have : z = w := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    subst this
    have h1 := mem_ball_iff_norm.mp hw
    have h2 := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz
    linarith
  have hcont : ContinuousOn g (Metric.sphere c R) := hg.continuousOn.mono (by rw [closure_ball c hR.ne']; exact Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall)
  have hI : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball c R, CircleIntegrable (fun z => (z - w)⁻¹ • g z) c R := by
    intro w hw
    apply ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable hR.le
    exact ContinuousOn.smul (ContinuousOn.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (hne w hw)) hcont
  have e : Set.EqOn (fun z => g z / ((z - a) * (z - b))) (fun z => (a - b)⁻¹ * ((z - a)⁻¹ • g z - (z - b)⁻¹ • g z)) (Metric.sphere c R) := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 := hne a ha z hz
    have h2 := hne b hb z hz
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_congr hR.le e, circleIntegral.integral_const_mul, circleIntegral.integral_sub (hI a ha) (hI b hb), hg.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul ha, hg.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul hb]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (c a b : ℂ) (R : ℝ), DiffContOnCl ℂ g (Metric.ball c R) → a ∈ Metric.ball c R → b ∈ Metric.ball c R → a ≠ b → (∮ z in C(c, R), g z / ((z - a) * (z - b))) = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((g a - g b) / (a - b))
